data.name: Ashhub
data.gender_notes: Ashhub is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ashhabah’ meaning ‘to breathe, to live’. This name is a reminder of the blessings of life and the importance of cherishing each moment. The name Ashhub carries the meaning “Breathing, Living” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashhub usually hope their child will grow to embody breathing, living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Celebrating the gift of life and the blessings of Allah.
data.etymology: Ashhub belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breathing, Living.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashhub total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Ashhub
in_english.meaning: One who testifies to Allah's oneness, one who is firm in faith, one who submits to Allah's will
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashhub is derived from the Arabic root Ash-ha-da, which means to testify or bear witness. In Islamic tradition, Ashhub is considered a name of truth and courage, and one who bears witness to Allah's oneness and submits to His will. The name is mentioned in Imam Bukhari's Sahih, and is associated with the qualities of sincerity, humility, and reliance on Allah. Ashhub is also a name that conveys a sense of strength and resilience, and is said to inspire the bearer to live a life of righteousness and virtue.
